# Results -- Study 325 (Crypto-Fear-Greed) on real BTC-USD daily tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). Recipe: each day,
read a **price-derived Fear & Greed proxy gauge** (0--100, built from BTC's own
realised volatility, drawdown-from-trailing-high and trailing momentum); go
**long** BTC in Extreme Fear (gauge < 25), **short** in Extreme Greed
(gauge >= 75), flat otherwise; hold one day (one-day execution lag -- the gauge
known at the close of day t earns day t+1's return). Pinned against the
unconditional drift, a shuffled-gauge null, a block-bootstrap Sharpe CI,
sub-periods, a crypto-realistic cost sweep, and a synthetic positive control.
As-of **2026-05-31** (the partial June bar is dropped).*

> **Why a proxy and not the live index?** The alternative.me crypto Fear & Greed
> API is network-blocked in this environment and has no long, clean, free
> historical archive. This study does **not** hardcode a curated sentiment table
> (that is the *equities* study, 255-fear-greed-index). It rebuilds a transparent
> price-derived gauge from the same volatility/momentum ingredients the published
> index weights most heavily -- so the result speaks to the *price-derived*
> contrarian claim, not the social-media/search index. That caveat is the study's
> 3rd axis.

## Data stamp

| Source | Window | Shape | Fingerprint (close) |
|--------|--------|-------|---------------------|
| BTC-USD daily close (yfinance, auto-adjusted) -> price-derived F&G proxy gauge | 2014-09-17 -> 2026-05-31 | 4,275 days (4,125 gauge rows, 4,124 with forward return) | `26bfad39f376` |

## Forward daily return by Fear & Greed band

| Band | n days | Forward return (ann) | HAC *t* | Hit rate |
|------|--------|----------------------|---------|----------|
| Extreme Fear (<25) | 603 | +125.49%/yr | +2.12 | 0.531 |
| Fear (25-44) | 850 | +35.18%/yr | +0.77 | 0.515 |
| Neutral (45-55) | 619 | -3.01%/yr | -0.07 | 0.507 |
| Greed (56-74) | 1363 | +53.64%/yr | +1.66 | 0.528 |
| **Extreme Greed (>=75)** | 689 | **+173.76%/yr** | **+3.58** | 0.550 |

Unconditional forward daily return: **+71.91%/yr**. Extreme-Fear days do beat the
drift (+125%/yr, *t* = 2.12) -- but so does the whole BTC tape, and the **single
strongest band is Extreme Greed** (+173.76%/yr, *t* = +3.58). The pattern is
broadly the *opposite* of the contrarian claim: BTC keeps running when the gauge
says greed, an artefact of crypto's powerful trending / momentum regime.

## Primary specification -- the contrarian fear-minus-greed spread

| Series | Mean | Ann. | HAC *t* | Ann. Sharpe | Hit |
|--------|------|------|---------|-------------|-----|
| **Spread (long fear, short greed)** | **-2.93 bps/d** | **-10.68%/yr** | **-0.86** | -0.26 | 0.153 |
| Long-only fear excess over market | +14.7 bps/d | +53.58%/yr | +0.90 | -- | -- |
| Linear sentiment tilt (slope per 50 gauge pts) | +9.44 bps | -- | +0.73 | -- | -- |

- The contrarian spread HAC *t* = **-0.86** -- not only short of the *t* >= 2 bar,
  it is the **wrong sign**: shorting greed and buying fear *lost* money.
- Block-bootstrap (circular, block = 20) 95% CI on the spread Sharpe (ann):
  **[-0.87, +0.36]**, with **79% of resamples negative** -- the interval sits
  mostly below zero.
- The linear gauge slope is +9.44 bps per 50 points (*t* = 0.73) and is the
  **wrong sign** for the contrarian claim (it implies more greed -> higher next-day
  return) and is statistically indistinguishable from zero.

## Sub-period analysis -- no era rescues it

| Period | Spread/yr | HAC *t* | n days |
|--------|-----------|---------|--------|
| 2016-2019 | -11.74%/yr | -0.46 | 1461 |
| 2020-2022 | +10.94%/yr | +0.51 | 1096 |
| 2023-2026 | -23.94%/yr | -1.50 | 1246 |

No sub-period clears *t* = 2; the best slice (2020-2022, the post-COVID rally) is
a noisy +0.51 and the most recent era is the worst. There is no stable contrarian
edge in any slice.

## Shuffled-gauge null -- the signal is indistinguishable from noise

Permuting the gauge column 2,000 times (breaking any link to forward returns)
gives a null spread-mean distribution centred at **-0.31 bps/d** (std 2.93 bps).
The *real* spread mean is **-2.93 bps/d** -- it sits at the **17.9th percentile**
of the shuffled null (i.e. *worse* than most random relabellings, consistent with
the wrong-sign contrarian effect being noise around a momentum tape).

## Tradability -- turnover and costs

The overlay is flat **68.7%** of days (~14.6% long, ~16.7% short), with **~32
round-trips per year** (362 trades over 4,124 days).

| One-way cost / funding | Net spread | Net HAC *t* |
|------------------------|-----------|-------------|
| 10 bps one-way + 1000 bps/yr short funding | -15.56%/yr | -1.25 |

Crypto shorts are expensive (perp funding + spot borrow run into the high
hundreds of bps/yr); charging a realistic 1000 bps/yr drives the already-negative
gross spread further negative. There is no edge to erode -- gross is already a
wrong-sign loser.

## Positive control -- the machinery finds the effect when it is planted

On the deterministic synthetic BTC tape (`data.synthetic_btc`, stochastic-vol
random walk + an AR(1) mean-reversion knob), the same overlay recovers a planted
contrarian premium monotonically:

| Planted reversion | Spread mean/d | Spread HAC *t* |
|-------------------|---------------|----------------|
| 0.00 (null) | -3.39 bps (chance) | -0.83 (within null band) |
| 0.20 | +4.14 bps | +1.11 |
| 0.35 | +10.99 bps | +2.88 |
| 0.50 | +22.31 bps | **+5.37** |

The engine clears *t* > 2 once genuine short-horizon reversion exists -- it just
finds the *opposite* (momentum) on the real BTC tape. **A synthetic control is a
machinery proof, never market evidence** (METHODOLOGY -> the inference bar); the
Signal stamp below rests only on the real BTC numbers.

## Verdict

- **Signal -- NONE.** Contrarian spread HAC *t* = **-0.86** (wrong sign);
  bootstrap Sharpe CI [-0.87, +0.36], 79% negative; the real spread sits at the
  17.9th percentile of a shuffled-gauge null; the band pattern is the *opposite*
  of the claim (Extreme **Greed** is the strongest band, *t* = +3.58, a momentum
  artefact). **NONE.**
- **Tradability -- MIRAGE.** There is no gross edge to trade -- it is a wrong-sign
  loser before costs, and crypto-realistic short funding only deepens the loss.
  "Buy crypto fear" is a story told about a powerfully trending asset, not a
  timing signal. **MIRAGE.**
- **Proxy gauge (3rd axis).** The gauge is a transparent *price-derived* proxy
  (vol + drawdown + momentum), not the alternative.me social-media/search index;
  the result certifies the price-derived contrarian claim, the part the published
  index is actually dominated by.
